Job Summary This role focuses on designing and optimizing robust data platforms using Apache Iceberg for a hi tech environment ensuring reliable data ingestion storage and access for analytics teams. Optimize data storage layouts file formats and metadata management within Apache Iceberg environments to achieve improved query performance and resource utilization. Collaborate closely with product managers data analysts and software engineers to translate business requirements into well structured data models and reliable data services. Establish robust data governance practices including schema evolution strategies data retention rules and catalog management to maintain consistent and compliant datasets. Implement monitoring and alerting for data workflows by configuring metrics logs and health checks that proactively identify data integrity or performance issues. Job Summary Serve as a business analyst specializing in payment products and automatic payment workflows translating complex business needs into clear functional solutions that optimize hybrid day shift operations while collaborating across global teams. Apply deep Spanish language fluency to support stakeholders refine payment processes and enhance secure transaction experiences for customers and society. Responsibilities Analyze current automatic payment processes and payment product functionalities to identify gaps inefficiencies and opportunities for continuous improvement that enhance operational reliability and customer trust in transactions. Document detailed business requirements for payment product features by engaging with stakeholders across business and technology teams and ensuring that specifications are precise and aligned with regulatory and compliance expectations. Collaborate with product owners and technical teams to validate functional payment solutions and ensure that designed workflows for automatic payments are efficient scalable and user centric for a diverse customer base. Translate complex payment product concepts and rules into clear user stories acceptance criteria and process maps that guide development activities and support transparent communication among multilingual stakeholders. Perform detailed impact analysis for proposed changes to automatic payment systems and payment product configurations to minimize risk and safeguard the stability of transaction processing environments. Coordinate and execute functional testing for payment products including regression and integration testing to verify that automatic payment features operate correctly across upstream and downstream systems. Develop and maintain documentation for payment product functionalities including process flows configuration details and reference guides that support cross functional teams in hybrid work settings. Engage with operations and support teams to analyze incident trends in payment processing and propose targeted enhancements that reduce failure rates and improve customer experience outcomes. Use Spanish native language skills to facilitate workshops requirement gathering sessions and status communications with Spanish speaking stakeholders thereby improving clarity and alignment on payment product initiatives. Monitor key performance indicators related to automatic payment success rates processing times and exception volumes and produce analytical reports that inform data driven decisions for product refinement. Support risk and compliance reviews by explaining business logic behind payment product functionalities and documenting controls that contribute to secure and ethically responsible financial transactions. Collaborate in a hybrid work model by effectively managing virtual and onsite interactions and maintaining consistent communication practices that keep cross regional teams informed on project progress. job_title: GenAI Architect – Generative AI & Agentic AI
location: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States; Jersey City, New Jersey, United States
description: About the role: As a GenAI Architect, you will make an impact by designing and delivering enterprise-scale Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions that accelerate business innovation and transform software engineering practices. You will be a valued member of our AI and Architecture team and collaborate closely with application engineering, cloud, data, security, DevOps, and business stakeholders to bring AI solutions from concept through production deployment. In this role, you will: Architect and deliver scalable Generative AI, LLM, Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions for enterprise applications. Design and build AI-powered applications, intelligent agents, orchestration workflows, reusable services, APIs, and accelerators. Develop architecture patterns for prompt engineering, context management, grounding, guardrails, model evaluation, and structured outputs. Lead the adoption of AI-assisted software engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and similar platforms to improve developer productivity and software quality. Establish best practices for responsible AI, LLMOps, observability, security, governance, CI/CD, and production monitoring while mentoring engineering teams and driving enterprise AI standards. Work model: We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Charlotte, NC. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. What you need to have to be considered: 10+ years of experience in solution architecture, application architecture, software engineering, AI/ML, or related technology disciplines. Hands-on experience architecting and delivering enterprise Generative AI and LLM-based applications. Proven experience building AI agents, copilots, RAG solutions, and LLM-powered workflows. Strong knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, retrieval strategies, agent orchestration, and model evaluation. Experience with AWS cloud services, preferably Amazon Bedrock, and cloud-native application architectures. Expertise with APIs, microservices, containers, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and distributed systems. Strong understanding of AI security, responsible AI, governance, observability, and production monitoring. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence technical and business teams. These will help you stand out: Experience with Palantir, enterprise AI platforms, vector databases, or enterprise knowledge management platforms. Experien

Working closely with cross-functional teams, regulatory authorities, and internal stakeholders, you will support pharmacovigilance activities and contribute to maintaining compliance with global regulatory requirements. Responsibilities Monitor and evaluate adverse event reports to ensure compliance with pharmacovigilance regulations and internal procedures. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyze, interpret, and communicate safety data effectively. Prepare safety reports and support regulatory submissions in accordance with applicable guidelines and timelines. Assist in the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of pharmacovigilance systems and processes. Conduct literature reviews and surveillance activities to identify potential safety signals and emerging risks. Support PV case processing activities while ensuring data quality, accuracy, and completeness. Contribute to risk assessment and safety monitoring activities for pharmaceutical products. Maintain accurate documentation and records to support audits, inspections, and regulatory compliance. Participate in process improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness. Stay current with pharmacovigilance regulations, industry trends, and best practices. Qualifications Degree in a relevant scientific discipline such as Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Medicine, Nursing, or a related field. Experience in Pharma Research & Development. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex safety data. Proficiency in pharmacovigilance data management and safety databases. Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate across multiple stakeholders. Experience in PV Case Processing. Certification in Pharmacovigilance or Drug Safety Management is preferred. Familiarity with risk management plans, safety assessments, and signal detection activities. Up-to-date knowledge of pharmacovigilance regulations, guidelines, and industry standards. Ability to mentor and support junior team members. Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining high-quality standards. Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Work Model We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 2–3 days a week in a Cognizant office in Sao Paulo, BR . Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. Benefits A career in one of the largest and fastest-growing IT services providers worldwide. On
